A learning demo exploring what computer vision can recognize. The sample scenes illustrate possibilities, not an announced project or deployed service.

Sample footage. Live detection.

The demo videos are recordings. The boxes and recognized items are created live as this device watches each frame.

It happens right here.

Once the vision model has downloaded, recognition runs in your browser on this device. Video frames aren’t sent to a server for analysis.

Give it something to find.

Switch to Camera and try apples, bananas, oranges or people. Keep them clearly visible and watch the recognized items light up.

This is object recognition, not identification. It can miss things or get them wrong—especially when objects are small, moving or partly hidden.
